svg.title: Now building: Fishing Boat Safety System
svg.desc: Capsize and distress detection for small Kerala fishing boats. A Random Forest runs on the ESP32 itself and relays a three-state alert to shore over LoRa, so it works exactly where there is no signal. Built with ESP32, C/C++, emlearn, LoRa, FastAPI, React. Phase 1 / 7 · Sensing Rig. Animation: a fishing boat rocks on the waves and sends an alert packet to a shore gateway.
